values.note: Village of Bay City (2025 season page): camper sites $45 a day, $300 a week, $1,150 a month, $2,500 a season; tent sites $25 a day per tent; public boat launch $5 a day. Read 2026-11-16.

hookups.source: https://baycitywi.gov/lodging/bay-city-campground/ ('Campground has 44 full hook-up sites and 6 tent sites')

values.note: 44 full-hookup camper sites and 6 tent sites; only 10 of the camper sites are let by the day, week or month, the rest are seasonal.
By phone only. Daily and weekly reservations open March 1, monthly February 1, for the 10 non-seasonal sites; holidays fill fast.

note: Village of Bay City campground on a sand point at the head of Lake Pepin (Mississippi River), 7 mi from Red Wing, MN; sand beach, public boat launch, fish-cleaning area, pavilion. Mostly seasonal: only 10 of the 44 hookup sites take daily, weekly or monthly campers (the village page lists 21-23, 34-38, 43-44; its 2025 map marks 19, 20, 23, 34-38, 43, 44). The Lake Pepin row (35-44) sits about 35-40 m from the water across a riprap line and the beach. Seasonal flooding may delay the opening. --Claude
summary: Village page and 2025 map confirm 44 full-hookup + 6 tent sites, $45 a day (weekly/monthly/seasonal rates too), Apr 15-Oct 15 season, phone reservations from Mar 1; only 10 hookup sites are non-seasonal (~23% of RV sites, ~30% with tents): long-stay caveat kept in the note. Lakefront kept for the Lake Pepin row 35-44 (riprap + beach between). Site count 25 -> 50.
flags: LONG-STAY (public park, test 4): 10 of 44 hookup sites take daily/weekly/monthly campers ('Available sites for monthly weekly and daily reservations: 21, 22, 23, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 43 and 44'); with the 6 tent sites ~16 of 50 (~30%) are not seasonal -> keep with the mostly-seasonal caveat (in the note). Rates posted for day/week/month/season, map revised 6/24/2025. Google Maps 4.6 (80 reviews).
Village page and its own map disagree on which sites are non-seasonal: text lists 21, 22, 23, 34-38, 43, 44; map legend (rev. 6/24/2025) lists 19, 20, 23, 34-38, 43, 44. Both kept in the note.

Waterfront lakefront kept: the Lake Pepin row (sites 35-44; non-seasonal 35, 36, 37, 38, 43, 44) lies between the camp road and the beach, pads about 35-40 m from the water over open ground (a riprap line, then sand beach) on Esri imagery, e.g. ~44.5799,-92.4552 and ~44.5795,-92.4555. Riprap caveat is in the note. Sold nightly only on those six numbers.
Page still says 'We are now open for the 2025 season!' (no 2026 statement); rates are therefore dated 2025.
